name: What's for Dinner? (Nomis)
tagline: Photograph the fridge and get tonight's answer: cook this, use that up first
description: Point your camera at the fridge or the cupboard and it decides tonight's meal from what you actually have. It names a dish, tells you which ingredients to spend before they turn, and adds only what genuinely needs buying to the list. A deciding-fatigue shortcut for anyone who cooks for a household.
author: cradrrat
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
